name: They Shoot Pictures 1000 Greatest Films
description: The critics' canon aggregated by TheyShootPictures.com. Large and updated yearly, so configurable.
_howto: To populate: drop tspdt_1000.csv here with columns Title,Year (optional tmdbId), OR set 'tmdbListId' to a mirroring public TMDB list id. Then re-run build_lists.py.
